Detailed product description
The Shimadzu Autograph AGS-X is a universal testing machine that combines precision, safety and ease of use for a wide range of applications. Designed to perform tensile, compression, flex and peel tests, it incorporates TRAPEZIUM X software for powerful data analysis. Its ergonomic design and intuitive functions provide an optimal working environment, while its wide range of accessories allows the device to be adapted to different materials and regulatory requirements. The AGS-X guarantees reliable results while improving laboratory productivity.

 Description
Shimadzu Autograph AGS-X: a high-performance solution for mechanical testing
The Shimadzu Autograph AGS-X is a universal testing machine designed to provide practical and reliable solutions for a wide range of applications, from metals to polymers, ceramics and composites. With its precise load and deformation control capabilities, this device allows users to perform standardised tests in accordance with ISO, ASTM and JIS standards, while ensuring maximum safety and ease of use.
The AGS-X series is equipped with TRAPEZIUM X software, which provides a user-friendly interface for configuring test methods, acquiring data and generating detailed reports. This software automates repetitive sequences of operations, optimising working time and reducing the risk of human error. In addition, it supports the creation of multiple graphs and real-time display, facilitating the analysis of results during the test.
The high-precision load cell system ensures accurate measurement of the applied force, with an accuracy of ±0.5% over a wide operating range. Fast sampling capabilities at 1 millisecond ensure that no critical variations are missed, even during dynamic tests or tests on materials with non-linear behaviour. Autotuning functions allow control parameters to be adjusted in real time based on the data collected, making the process safer and more efficient, especially for fragile materials that require fine adjustments at the start of testing.
Operator safety is at the heart of the AGS-X design. It features devices such as a vertically opening protective cover, emergency stop switches on both sides and adjustable stroke limiters that can be set with a single movement. These features help to minimise risks when handling samples that are prone to sudden fragmentation or breakage.
The AGS-X offers great flexibility thanks to its wide range of accessories: pneumatic grips for films and textiles, spherical compression plates, non-contact video extensometers, thermostatic chambers for temperature-controlled testing, and specialised devices for fibre-reinforced composites. These complementary tools allow the AGS-X to be perfectly adapted to the specific needs of each laboratory, whether for research and development or quality control.
 Features
Automatic adjustment of control parameters (autotuning)
Dual-control emergency stop function
Vertically opening safety guard with interlock
Adjustable travel limiters with one-touch operation
Intuitive user interface on main panel and via PC
Memory for 40 test methods (20 on PC and 20 on integrated controller)
Compatible with tensile, compression, bending, peel and cyclic tests
Customised report generation in PDF, Word and Excel formats
Macro integration for automated test sequences
Large working area for optimal comfort when positioning samples
 Technical Details
Load capacity range: 10 kN, 20 kN, 50 kN, 100 kN, 300 kN depending on model
Force measurement accuracy: ±0.5% over a range of 1/500 to 1/1 of the load cell
Crosshead speed: 0.001 to 1600 mm/min (depending on model)
Maximum return speed: up to 2200 mm/min
Fast sampling: 1 millisecond interval
Digital display with 0.001 mm resolution
Compliance with standards: ISO 7500-1, ASTM E4, JIS B7721
TRAPEZIUM X or TRAPEZIUM LITE X software included
Operating temperature: 5 °C to 40 °C
Power supply: 100–240 V AC (tabletop) or three-phase 200–440 V AC (floor type)
 Compatible Accessories
Flat and wedge-shaped pneumatic clamps for different types of samples
Fixed and spherical compression plates
TRViewX non-contact video extensometers
Automatic SIE extensometers for gauge position detection
Compact TCE thermostatic chambers (-70 °C to +280 °C)
Devices for peel, shear and friction tests
Grips for films, textiles, rubbers and composite materials
I/O expansion boxes for sensors and controllers
Jog Controller for precise manual adjustment of the crosshead

Product Conditions
 Close panel
 Brand New
The device has never been used, and all functionalities as well as its aesthetic condition match those of a factory-new product. The product is in its original packaging.
Functionality: 
The product functions perfectly, having never been used before.
Aesthetic Aspect:
The aesthetic aspect is impeccable, corresponding to factory condition.
Wear:
The product has never been used and contains the default factory settings.
 Perfect Condition
The device shows minimal wear, optimal functionality, and preserved aesthetics.
Functionality:
All functions specific to the product type are tested and operational.
Aesthetic Aspect:
The signs of usage are minimal and imperceptible at a distance of 1 meter. The original colors are vivid, giving the product an appearance equivalent to that of a new product at a distance of 1 meter.
Wear:
Wear is limited to minimal, barely noticeable signs. Components prone to wear, such as
buttons, touch screens, and cables are in excellent condition. If present, moving parts
function comparably to those of a new product.
 Good Condition
The device exhibits moderate signs of wear and slight visual alteration visible at a 1-meter
observation distance, while still maintaining its functionality.
Functionality:
All functions specific to the product type are tested and operational.
Aesthetic Aspect:
The product may show signs of use such as scratches, slight discoloration (moderate
yellowing), noticeable at a 1-meter observation distance. Nevertheless, the overall
appearance remains neat and professional.
Wear:
Wear is more pronounced, especially on components exposed to regular use. Moving parts
may show more evident signs of wear, although their functionality remains ensured.
 Fair Condition
The device is fully functional and exhibits pronounced visual defects and noticeable signs of wear with material alteration.
Functionality:
All functions specific to the product type are tested and operational. Although the product exhibits more pronounced wear, it does not affect its operational effectiveness.
Aesthetic Aspect
At a 1-meter observation distance, the product may display pronounced defects, resulting in material loss or deformation, including fractures, cracks, breakage, and other similar alterations.
Wear:
Wear is pronounced and visible. Moving parts may show evident signs of wear, although their functionality remains ensured. This category implies intense usage but without compromising overall performance.
